problem_spec:
def problem_spec
-- function signature
(implementation: String → String)
-- inputs
(str: String) :=
-- spec
let spec (result : String) :=
  result.data.all (fun c => c.isLower) →
  result.length = str.length ∧
  (∀ i, i < str.length →
    let c := str.data[i]!
    let c' := result.data[i]!
    ((c'.toNat - 97) + 2 * 2) % 26 = (c.toNat - 97))
-- program termination
∃ result,
  implementation str = result ∧
  spec result
